name: grasshopper
title_zh: 参数化建模师的手写板：数据树接错线它会当场标红
tagline_zh: 在 Rhino 里写 Grasshopper 定义、排组件、理数据树、跑求解器，不用切窗口。
tagline_en: Author, wire, and solve Grasshopper definitions inside Rhino—no tab switching. Python/C# both work, and it.
desc_en: Parametric definition authoring, component placement & graph wiring, data tree alignment, solver execution, and Grasshopper automation via Rhino MCP server (g1_* tools & Python/C#). Use when the user asks to create, debug, wire, or solve Grasshopper definitions, manage data trees (Graft/Flatten/Simplify), or mentions /grasshopper, /gh, "grasshopper", or "GH". Do NOT use for standalone Rhino docume
why_zh: 它把 GH 的图面操作压成可审阅的文本流：每个组件、每条连线。
why_en: Turns GH canvas actions into an auditable text stream—every component, wire, and tree op is logged, so you can replay and debug.
limit_zh: 只认 Rhino MCP server（g1_* 工具）已连上的文档；不处理纯 Rhino 建模命令。
limit_en: Requires Rhino MCP server (g1_* tools) on a live doc; no standalone Rhino modeling, no non-GH visualization. Error messages get verbose beyond.
title_en: Parametric modeler's scratchpad: flags miswired data trees.
